title: High-Level Synthesis Flows
description: Compiles C/C++ algorithms to RTL with high-level synthesis instead of hand-writing Verilog. Pragmas guide pipelining, unrolling, and memory partitioning; the tool explores the area-speed tradeoff. HLS brings hardware acceleration within reach of software teams.
key_mechanisms: Write the algorithm in synthesizable C++

demo.title: Demo — High-Level Synthesis Flows

title: RTL Pipeline Design
description: Designs hand-crafted RTL pipelines with explicit stage registers and valid/ready handshakes. Each stage does fixed work per cycle, so throughput is one result per cycle at steady state. It is the highest-performance and highest-effort path.

demo.title: Demo — RTL Pipeline Design

title: AXI-Stream Interfaces
description: Connects pipeline stages with AXI-Stream interfaces for standard flow control. TDATA carries the payload while TVALID/TREADY implement backpressure; TLAST marks packet ends. Standard interfaces make pipelines composable.

demo.title: Demo — AXI-Stream Interfaces

title: DSP Slice Mapping
description: Maps multiply-accumulate chains onto dedicated DSP slices instead of fabric logic. DSP48 slices do 27x18-bit multiplies at full clock speed with minimal power. FIR filters and neural nets live or die by DSP mapping.

demo.title: Demo — DSP Slice Mapping

title: BRAM Buffering
description: Buffers pipeline data in block RAM for line buffers and FIFOs. BRAM gives deterministic single-cycle access at hundreds of MHz; FIFOs built from BRAM absorb rate mismatches between stages. Sizing buffers is the key design decision.

demo.title: Demo — BRAM Buffering

title: Clock Domain Crossing
description: Crosses clock domains safely with dual-clock FIFOs and synchronizer chains. Metastability is a physical reality; two-flop synchronizers and gray-coded pointers make crossings reliable. Every CDC path gets formally verified.

demo.title: Demo — Clock Domain Crossing

title: PCIe DMA Engines
description: Moves data between host memory and the FPGA with PCIe DMA engines. Descriptor-driven DMA streams gigabytes per second without CPU involvement; the driver manages rings and completions. It is the standard host-FPGA data path.

demo.title: Demo — PCIe DMA Engines

title: Partial Reconfiguration
description: Swaps accelerator regions at runtime while the static shell keeps running. Partial bitstreams reconfigure one region without disturbing PCIe links or memory controllers. It lets one FPGA time-share many accelerators.

demo.title: Demo — Partial Reconfiguration

title: Fixed-Point Conversion
description: Converts floating-point algorithms to fixed point for efficient FPGA math. Fixed-point multiplies use a fraction of the resources; bit-width analysis picks the minimum width that preserves accuracy. DSP chains demand it.

demo.title: Demo — Fixed-Point Conversion

title: Pipeline Balancing
description: Balances stage delays so no single stage limits the clock. Retiming moves registers across combinational logic to equalize the critical path. A balanced pipeline runs at the target frequency; an unbalanced one does not.

demo.title: Demo — Pipeline Balancing

title: Floorplanning
description: Constrains placement with floorplanning to meet timing on large designs. Pblocks keep related logic close, shortening the wires that limit frequency. It is manual work that pays off on congested designs.

demo.title: Demo — Floorplanning

title: Timing Closure
description: Closes timing by iterating synthesis, placement, and constraints until all paths meet. Setup and hold analysis across process corners proves the design runs at speed. No bitstream ships without clean timing.

demo.title: Demo — Timing Closure

title: Co-Simulation
description: Co-simulates the HLS C++ model against the RTL to prove functional equivalence. The same testbench drives both; mismatches are bugs in pragmas or interfaces. It catches what unit tests miss.
key_mechanisms: Drive C++ and RTL from one testbench

demo.title: Demo — Co-Simulation

title: Bitstream Management
description: Versions and deploys bitstreams like software releases. Bitstreams are hashed, signed, and staged; rollback keeps the last known good. It brings DevOps discipline to hardware.

demo.title: Demo — Bitstream Management

title: Power Estimation
description: Estimates FPGA power from switching activity before tapeout-equivalent commitment. Vector-based analysis with real stimulus beats spreadsheet guesses. It sizes power supplies and cooling correctly.

demo.title: Demo — Power Estimation
